entities.name: Khalni Heart
entities.description: Magical flower that is an outgrowth of the soul of Zendikar.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Zendikari planeswalker who found the Khalni Heart in Bala Ged and rekindled her connection to the plane.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: Demon and former planeswalker who sought to use the Khalni Heart to reignite his spark.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Plane whose soul the Khalni Heart grows from.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: Devastated continent where the Khalni Heart had a new bud.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Invaders whose onslaught devastated Bala Ged.

entities.name: Khalni Stone
entities.description: Ancient mana refractor at the heart of Ora Ondor feeding the Impossible Garden.

entities.name: Ora Ondor
entities.description: Place in Akoum at the heart of which lies the Khalni Stone.

entities.name: Impossible Garden
entities.description: Garden fed by the Khalni Stone whose plants mutate elves.

events.summary: Led by visions, Nissa travels into Bala Ged to find the Khalni Heart and rekindles her connection to the plane.
events.quote: Through it, Nissa rekindled her connection to the plane

events.summary: Nissa runs afoul of Ob Nixilis, bests him, removes the Khalni Heart to safety and escapes.
events.quote: Nissa bested Ob Nixilis, removed the Khalni Heart to safety, and escaped.

relations.note: She bested him over the Khalni Heart.
The Stone's mana truly comes from a Khalni Heart.
relations.quote: The true source of the refracting Khalni Stone's mana is in fact a Khalni Heart
